scripts.features: Anti slippery!!! Use when noli okay? Read this.
scripts.script:
-----Use when noli
--!strict
-- This script makes the character dash along the ground.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local Humanoid = Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local HumanoidRootPart = Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- The speed of the original Void Rush from your config
local ORIGINAL_DASH_SPEED = 60

local isOverrideActive = false
local connection

local function startOverride()
    if isOverrideActive then return end
    isOverrideActive = true

    -- Connect a loop to force the character to move forward
    connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        -- Forcefully set WalkSpeed and AutoRotate on every frame
        Humanoid.WalkSpeed = ORIGINAL_DASH_SPEED
        Humanoid.AutoRotate = false
        
        local direction = HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector
        local horizontalDirection = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z).Unit
        
        -- Use Humanoid.Move to directly move the character
        Humanoid:Move(horizontalDirection)
    end)
end

local function stopOverride()
    if not isOverrideActive then return end
    isOverrideActive = false

    -- Restore original settings
    Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16 -- Or whatever your default walk speed is
    Humanoid.AutoRotate = true
    Humanoid:Move(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)) -- Stop the character from moving
    
    if connection then
        connection:Disconnect()
        connection = nil
    end
end

-- Main loop to detect when to activate and deactivate the override
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local voidRushState = Character:GetAttribute("VoidRushState")

    if voidRushState == "Dashing" then
        startOverride()
    else
        stopOverride()
    end
end)

-- Helper functions
local function createPart(name, size, color, cframe, parent)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.CFrame = cframe
	part.Anchored = false
	part.CanCollide = true
	part.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(color)
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.Parent = parent
	return part
end

local function weld(part0, part1)
	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = part0
	weld.Part1 = part1
	weld.Parent = part0
end

-- ESP Name
local function addBillboard(part, text)
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui", part)
	bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 30)
	bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
	bb.Adornee = part

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", bb)
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
	label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Text = text
end

-- Hair Part
local function createHair(gender, head)
	local hair = Instance.new("Part")
	hair.Size = gender == "Boy" and Vector3.new(2, 1, 2) or Vector3.new(2.5, 1.5, 2.5)
	hair.BrickColor = BrickColor.new(gender == "Boy" and "Reddish brown" or "Hot pink")
	hair.Anchored = false
	hair.CanCollide = false
	hair.Name = "Hair"
	hair.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.6, 0)
	hair.Parent = head.Parent
	weld(head, hair)
end

-- Spawn NPC
local function spawnNPC()
	local nameText = nameBox.Text ~= "" and nameBox.Text or "NPC"
	local gender = genderSelect.Text

	local model = Instance.new("Model", npcFolder)
	model.Name = nameText

	local spawnPos = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position or Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
	local basePos = spawnPos + Vector3.new(5, 3, 0)

	local torso = createPart("Torso", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), "Bright blue", CFrame.new(basePos), model)
	local head = createPart("Head", Vector3.new(2, 1, 2), "Bright yellow", torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0), model)
	local lArm = createPart("LeftArm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), "Bright green", torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(-1.5, 0, 0), model)
	local rArm = createPart("RightArm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), "Bright green", torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(1.5, 0, 0), model)
	local lLeg = createPart("LeftLeg", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), "Bright red", torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(-0.5, -2, 0), model)
	local rLeg = createPart("RightLeg", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), "Bright red", torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(0.5, -2, 0), model)

	local hum = Instance.new("Humanoid", model)

	weld(torso, head)
	weld(torso, lArm)
	weld(torso, rArm)
	weld(torso, lLeg)
	weld(torso, rLeg)

	createHair(gender, head)
	addBillboard(head, nameText)

	model.PrimaryPart = torso
	model:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(basePos))

	-- Movement loop
	task.spawn(function()
		while model and model.Parent do
			local moveTo = torso.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-10, 10), 0, math.random(-10, 10))
			hum:MoveTo(moveTo)
			hum.MoveToFinished:Wait()
			task.wait(1)
		end
	end)
end

spawnBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(spawnNPC)
